The constructor creates the services, wraps them in
the audit decorators and hands them to the
primary adapters. Before serving it ensures the
system account (used by the CLI and the tasks) and,
if nobody can administer, creates "admin" with a
random password shown only once on the
Refuses the handshake without a session (401) or
from another site (403). Each room relays the Yjs
edits without decoding them, keeps them in memory
for whoever joins later, and saves the text with
ITextEditing, based on the last fingerprint it knows.
Driving ports belong to the domain.

An installation has a single catalog, so
getCatalog() returns the aggregate to change it.
save() compares the version (optimistic locking) and
throws VersionConflict if someone else saved it first.
CatalogIndex records its events and the persistence
adapter, inside save(), writes the aggregate and its
pending events in the same transaction. Nothing else
reads the pending ones, publishes them on the bus and marks them.
Delivery is at least once: IChangeLog.register
ignores an EventId it already recorded.

a collection (guest User + SharedLink), ingesting a
file or creating a collection (CatalogIndex + User);
